identity_rule_as_stated: A certified Native Hawaiian business is a business that is at least 50% owned or controlled by Native Hawaiians, who have had their ancestry verified via one of the services or agencies listed; nonprofits qualify if Board of Directors is at least 50% Native Hawaiian, ancestry verified
entries_visible: Kū-A-Kanaka LLC; Kanaka Economic Development Alliance (self-listing); categories incl. retail/fashion, farms, legal, construction
format: web directory (searchable, listing archive at /listing/, category archives, certification page)
notes: Only source found with an explicit stated ownership threshold plus ancestry verification requirement; includes nonprofits (label per-entry). Operates in and outside Hawaii. Very scrapeable structure.

publisher: Native Hawaiian Hospitality Association (NaHHA) + Native Hawaiian Chambers of Commerce (Hawaiʻi Island, Maui, Oʻahu, Kauaʻi)
identity_rule_as_stated: features 'ʻōiwi-owned entities operating in Hawaiʻi' / 'Native Hawaiian-owned businesses' — no threshold or verification method stated in results
entries_visible: categories only: restaurants, boutiques, lei stands, lawyers, lomilomi practitioners, physical therapists
format: web directory (mobile-friendly, searchable by category/location, free listing via sign-up page)
official_status: community (funded by Hawaiʻi Tourism Authority, Kamehameha Schools, OHA)
notes: Launched Sept 2021. Listing is free and appears self-serve; verification process not stated in any snippet — check sign-up page terms when fetching is possible.

source: OHA Loan Programs — Native Hawaiian Business Owners directory
identity_rule_as_stated: OHA loans require 'confirmation of one's Hawaiian ancestry' (via OHA Hawaiian Registry Program, which verifies 'Hawaiian ancestry through biological parentage regardless of blood quantum'); directory page itself lets borrowers add their business — rule for the page not separately stated
entries_visible: success stories: Field Trip Friends, Flavors of Italy LLC, Destination Marketing Hawaii, Native Intelligence, Mo ʻOno Hawaiʻi, Hāloalaunuiākea Early Learning Center, Lohea Audio, Kalaka Nui Inc., Kuleana Coral Restoration
notes: OHA has NO business registry; its Hawaiian Registry verifies individuals only. This borrower-showcase directory is the closest OHA business list; population = OHA loan clients (ancestry-verified individuals), so high identity confidence but coverage limited to borrowers who opt in.
